main_text.p: ænigma, Ezech.17.2. Futur. אֲחוֹדֶה־נָא לָכֶם חִידָה Proponam nunc vobis ænigma, Jud.14.12.

חִידָה f. Ænigma, Sermo occultus,unde intelligitur res alia, scribit Kimchi, Ezech.17.2. Aff. חִידָתְךָ Aenigma tuum, Jud.14.13. חִידָתִי Aenigma meum,verf.18. Plural. חִידוֹת Aenigmata, Psal.78.2. בְּחִידוֹת Per ænigmata,Num.12.8. Aff. וְחִידוֹתָם Et ænigmata eorum, Prov.1.6.
אֲחִידָן f. p. Chald. Aenigmata; Dan.5.2. cum Aleph formativo.

חוּה Pih. Indicavit, Annunciavit: Chaldæis ufi- tatum Verbum: Infin. מְחַוֹּת דְּעֵי אִתְכֶם Indi- care sententiam meam vobis, Job.32.6. Futur. אֲחַוֵּא דְעֵי Indicabo sententiam meam, verf.10. cum ℵ loco ה: אֲחַוּךְ Indicabo tibi, Job.15.v.17. Chald.Futur. אֲחַוֵּא Indicabo, Dan.2.24. וּפִשְׁרָא נְחַוֵּא Et interpretatio- nem indicabimus, verf.4. דִּי יְחַוּנֵּי Qui indicare possit eam,vers.11. Aphel Infinit. יוּכַל לְהַחֲוָיָה Possit indicare, verf.10. Imperat. וּפִשְׁרָה הַחֲוֵנִי Et interpre- tationem ejus indicate mihi, verf.6. Futur. תְּהַחֲוֹן Indicaveritis, ibid. נְהַחֲוֵי Indicabimus, verf.37. דִּי פִשְׁרָה תְּהַחֲוּנַּנִי Quòd interpretationem possitis indicare mihi, vers.9.
אַחֲוָה f. Indicatio: Aff. וְאַחֲוָתִי Et indicationem meam, Job.13.17. Chald. Constr. וְאַחֵיָה אֲחִידָן Et indicatio ænigmatum, Dan.5.12.
חוּן מְחוֹז m. Terminus, Portus: Constr. אֶל־מְחוֹז חֵפֶץ Ad terminum voluntatis ipsorum, Psal.107.30.

חוֹחַ m. Spina, Job.31.40. Prov.20.9. Metaphoricè, Hamus, Uncus piscatorius, Job.40.21. Simi- lem usum vide in סִיר. Plur. כְּשׁוֹשַׁנָּה בֵּין הַחוֹחִים Sicut lilium inter spinas, Cant.2.2. בַּחוֹחִים In spinis, inter ve-

page.notes: Vowel points on Hebrew words are small and partly uncertain; consonants are copied as seen. Words marked [?] were not read with certainty; none were marked because the scan is legible at this resolution, but the pointing of the Hebrew headwords (חוּה, חוּן, חוֹחַ, אֲחִידָן) should be checked against the original. Hebrew "חִיּוֹר" in "Vide in" is a reading of a small cross-reference and should be verified. A small bullet mark stands in the left margin beside "Quòd"; it is not text. A small "o" below the last line is a printer's mark, not transcribed. The last line ends in a hyphen, so the entry continues on the next page.
